kinds.description: Open XML object kinds to list in native document order. Request only the kinds needed by the current local traversal, then follow returned refs through parentRef-scoped child pages. Text previews describe already located objects; they do not identify a document or select a source. Returned parentRef is the valid targetParentRef for inserting beside that object.

scope.description: Exact story-part URI such as /word/document.xml. This is not a table nativePath or ancestor filter.

parentRef.description: Optional revision-bound parent object ref. Returns only its nearest published child objects; when omitted, returns nearest children of each selected story part. This is never recursive descendant search.

limit.description: Maximum identities in this small page. Follow continuation in native order when the same structural inventory is required, then use returned refs to descend into the selected object.

output.description: Absolute path for a new JSON artifact containing this exact object page for later reuse.
